csv_project_name: Design Svc for McIntosh Power Plant Covered Parking
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Lakeland is seeking a qualified contractor to provide design, fabrication, shop drawings, and construction services for several covered parking structures at the C.D. McIntosh Power Plant. The project consists of eight (8) different parking areas throughout the plant. The selected contractor shall be responsible for design, preparation of shop drawings, fabrication, and full installation of the parking systems. The City of Lakeland may award all or part of the parking areas to one contractor based on pricing and other selection criteria.

title: Design Services for McIntosh Power Plant Covered Parking
short_description: Design-build covered parking structures at a power plant across eight parking areas.
project_location: C.D. McIntosh Power Plant, Lakeland, Polk County, Florida, USA
project_scope: Design-build project for several covered parking structures at the C.D. McIntosh Power Plant. The project comprises eight separate parking areas distributed throughout the plant. The selected contractor is to provide design, shop drawings, fabrication, and complete installation of the parking systems. The contracting authority may award all or only part of the eight parking areas to one contractor.
services: Design, fabrication, shop drawings, and construction/installation services for covered parking structures; requested disciplines include architecture, landscape architecture, civil engineering, structural engineering, and rehabilitation/refurbishment.
relevance_explanation:
- Covered parking structures can involve lightweight long-span steel canopies, which are generally relevant to sbp.
- The tender includes explicit design responsibilities, shop drawings, and structural engineering, not only construction.
- Multiple parking areas may offer repetitive but potentially efficient canopy structures.
- However, the project appears to be a relatively standard industrial parking canopy package rather than an architecturally ambitious or highly innovative special structure.
- No clear information is given on span lengths, structural system, sustainability features, or architectural complexity.
- It is a contractor-led design-build procurement, which may reduce direct entry for an engineering consultant unless via contractor collaboration.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available scope information: eight different covered parking areas at an existing power plant; includes design, shop drawings, fabrication, and full installation. A realistic cost estimate is not possible without area, span, material, foundation, or canopy type information.
fee_explanation: No planning fee is stated in the source. The procurement is design-build and combines design, fabrication, and installation, so an isolated engineering fee for sbp cannot be derived reliably from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualified contractor sought for design, fabrication, shop drawings, and construction services for covered parking structures. Specific reference or qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided source excerpt.
award_criteria: Pricing and other selection criteria; the City of Lakeland may award all or part of the parking areas to one contractor based on pricing and other selection criteria. Detailed weighting is not stated in the provided source excerpt.
